items.prompt: What happens when a sell fill exceeds the existing long quantity in this model?

options.text: Every share is matched to nonexistent long basis
options.why: Only the old long quantity can close.

options.text: The entire sell becomes unrealized with no close
options.why: The old long portion realizes its gain/loss.

options.text: Close the long first, then open excess short at the fill price
options.why: The reversal is split into closing and opening parts.

options.text: Discard the excess without recording cash
options.why: That would lose an executed obligation.

items.explanation: The new side gets the reversal fill price as its opening average; fees remain separately expensed.
